# Code-review instructions (condensed)

Scope: apply to prevarisc-migration changes. Reviewer role: check PHP7.1/Symfony4.4 compliance, security quick-checks, performance traps, Bootstrap2 residuals, tests.
Essential commands: castor symfony:analyse, castor symfony:cs, castor symfony:test, grep Bootstrap2 patterns.
Report: list blocking/important/minor items with file:line and action.
